company.name: Eight Sleep
company.shortDescription: Eight Sleep develops connected sleep systems that combine temperature regulation, biometric monitoring, and adjustable bed features.
company.description: Eight Sleep produces the Pod sleep system, which includes components such as a mattress cover, hub device, adjustable base, temperature-controlled blanket, and pillow cover designed to work together on a standard bed setup. Its system uses liquid-based thermal regulation to heat or cool the sleeping surface while sensors track metrics such as heart rate, sleep stages, and body temperature during the night. The platform analyzes sleep data to automatically adjust temperature and other settings, while a dual-zone design allows different conditions for each side of the bed. Additional features include automated elevation that can respond to snoring and integrated audio designed to help create a controlled sleep environment.

aiResearchSummary.text: Eight Sleep is researching detecting sleeping disorders, methods and systems for gathering and analyzing human biological signals, and bed device systems and methods that adjust conditions based on user data. Work on adjustable bed systems and methods thereof and systems and methods for controlling and regulating a temperature of an article of furniture uses sensors and fluid based temperature regulators. A sleep pod with personalized experiences and systems for detecting biological signals round out these areas of research and development.
